title: Chink Martin's group and the Dominoes at Woodman Hall
summary: He recalls playing with Chink Martin, the Christian brothers and the Dominoes (Willie Guitars, Nappy Lamar, Tony Barella), for little pay.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: And there was Chink Martin and, uh, uh, a fella by the name of Tots on the drums. He's dead now. And, uh, Hogan on the guitar. Well, I believe he's dead, too. I was Chink and I was about the only one living out that outfit. And this Frank Crixton played there. And this, and this fella, Charlie Crixton, who was a brother to Frank Crixton, he played with me. I think you had sure that picture before. With the Dominoes?

Willie Guitars? Yeah, Willie Guitars. And Nappy? Nappy Lamar and, uh, uh, Aleister Boucher. We all used to play at Woodman Hall on a Saturday night. That was a big deal. I think we got about three dollars and a ham sandwich to play on it.
Oh, who was the piano player in that picture? Uh, Nappy's brother or something? Brother, yeah.
What's his name? Uh, uh, not, not Will, uh, oh, I can't think of him. Oh, look, it'll come down.
Yeah. And who was the drummer?
Uh, Tony of Barella. He was a candy maker at Holmes'. Barella?
